name: Glint
description: One four-point star glint that pops in, turns a little and fades over 1 s, with a soft glow; place as many as you like.

controls.name: Position
controls.description: Where the glint's centre is, in frame pixels.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When it appears, in seconds; it is gone 1 s later.

controls.name: Size
controls.description: Width of the star at its biggest: 50 is the normal 140 px, 100 is double.

controls.name: Glow
controls.description: Strength of the soft glow behind it, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds.
